hypotheses.statement: Increasing u increases steady-state y (positive DC gain).
At u=0, y decays on its own toward ambient near 0.05 due to heat loss to the room.
Steady-state input needed to hold target 0.5 is moderate, roughly u in 0.3-0.6.
Step response has lag with time constant of tens of seconds and needs >100 s to settle.
There is no large dead zone: even u=0.1 produces a measurable rise versus u=0.
Steady-state y versus u is approximately linear up to the soft limit, without strong saturation.
Sensor noise is small, short-term variation <0.01 peak-to-peak.
